prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Save your new pet to your account", "Create or sign in to save your pet securely across your devices."]
1: ["Choose your desktop companion"]
2: ["How to control your desktop pet", "Drag to move around your screen. Right-click for options. Double click to chat or hide.", "Drag pet to move | Right-click for menu | Double-click to talk"]
3: ["Preparing your pet's room...", "Did you know? You can summon or minimize your pet anytime using hotkeys."]
4: ["Meet your interactive desktop companion", "Choose a pre-made pet or build a custom friend to keep you company while you work."]
5: ["Preset companions take ~30 seconds. Custom pet generation takes ~2 minutes."]
6: ["Sign in to back up your desktop pet", "Your pet, custom options, and memory are synced securely to your cloud account."]
7: ["Upload clear photos for custom generation", "For best results, upload well-lit, front-facing photos with clear background contrast."]
8: ["If your pet does not appear automatically on your screen, check your system tray icon."]
9: ["Your pet is active on your desktop!", "Your pet is now exploring your screen! Right-click to hide, drag to relocate, or double-click to chat.", "Use Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to open controls."]
